landing.title: OPEN PLAYLIST
landing.heroBody: <0>OpenPlaylist</0> is a shared queue, not a personal playlist. Viewers suggest music, filters validate requests, and you manage the stream in one click.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From viewer request to playback — everything is connected via settings, real-time updates, and an intuitive dashboard.

audienceBullets.sharedQueue: Shared queue with priorities and donations
audienceBullets.validation: YouTube track validation based on your settings
audienceBullets.sync: Real-time dashboard and viewer page sync

liveQueue.title: Live Queue
liveQueue.description: Viewer requests instantly hit the playlist. All connected users see updates in real time.

smartRules.title: Smart Rules
smartRules.description: Set limits for duration, views, cooldowns, and blocklists — you decide what goes on stream.

donations.title: Donations & Priority
donations.description: Set priorities for donations and Twitch chat roles — the queue adapts to your audience's input.

publicAccess.title: Public Access
publicAccess.description: Public playlists can be found by name or creator. Viewers submit tracks instantly.

create.title: Create Playlist
create.text: Log in via Twitch or email, configure flow/static mode, and set content rules.

share.title: Share Access
share.text: Share the playlist link so viewers can search and submit tracks, or connect a profile bot.

stream.title: Go Live
stream.text: Manage playback directly from your dashboard: play, skip, reorder, and view logs.
